content.content:
# Eval API (from the provided source)

## Core Struct: `Eval`

The `Eval` struct wraps a `GenerationalBox<Box<dyn Evaluator>>`. It implements `Clone` and `Copy`, enabling shared ownership.

### `new(evaluator: GenerationalBox<Box<dyn Evaluator + 'static>>) -> Self`

Constructs an `Eval` from a dynamic evaluator.

### `join<T: DeserializeOwned>(self) -> Result<T, EvalError>`

An async method that "wait[s] until the javascript task is finished and return the result." It uses `poll_fn` to repeatedly call `poll_join` on the evaluator, then deserializes the returned JSON value via `serde_json::from_value`.

### `send(&self, data: impl Serialize) -> Result<(), EvalError>`

Sends a serializable message to the JavaScript task. Internally serializes to `serde_json::Value` and delegates to the evaluator's `send`. Returns `EvalError::Finished` if the evaluator cannot be read.

### `recv<T: DeserializeOwned>(&mut self) -> Result<T, EvalError>`

An async method that "receive[s] a message from the javascript task" by polling `poll_recv` on the evaluator via `poll_fn`, then deserializing the result.

## IntoFuture Implementation

`Eval` implements `IntoFuture`, so you can await it directly. The output type is `Result<serde_json::Value, EvalError>`. It calls `self.join()` internally.

```rust
type Output = Result<serde_json::Value, EvalError>;
type IntoFuture = Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = Self::Output>>>;
```

## The `Evaluator` Trait

This is the platform-side interface with three methods:

| Method | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `send` | `&self, data: serde_json::Value -> Result<(), EvalError>` | Sends a message to the evaluated JavaScript |
| `poll_recv` | `&mut self, context: &mut Context<'_> -> Poll<Result<serde_json::Value, EvalError>>` | Receives queued messages from JavaScript |
| `poll_join` | `&mut self, context: &mut Context<'_> -> Poll<Result<serde_json::Value, EvalError>>` | Gets the return value of the JavaScript |

## Getting Return Values

There are two paths:

1. **`join()` — Await the final result.** Call `eval.join::<T>().await` to block until the JS task finishes and deserialize its return value into any `DeserializeOwned` type.

2. **`IntoFuture` — Await `Eval` directly.** Since `Eval` implements `IntoFuture`, you can write `let result: Result<serde_json::Value, EvalError> = eval.await;`, which delegates to `join()` and returns a raw `serde_json::Value`.

The `poll_join` method on the `Evaluator` trait is the low-level mechanism that drives the completion check each time the future is polled.

content.content:
# WebView & HTML Customization Options in `dioxus_desktop::Config`

Based on the documentation, here are all configuration methods related to webview behavior, HTML injection, and JavaScript/rendering settings:

## HTML & Content Injection

- **`with_custom_head`** — "Inject additional content into the document's HEAD." Useful for CSS/JS libraries.
- **`with_custom_index`** — "Use a custom index.html instead of the default Dioxus one." Requires valid HTML with a body element.
- **`with_prerendered`** — Sets pre-rendered HTML content (takes a `String`).
- **`with_root_name`** — "Set the name of the element that Dioxus will use as the root." Analogous to `React.render()` on a named element.

## Protocol & Network Customization

- **`with_custom_protocol`** — Registers a synchronous handler for a custom protocol (e.g., `"asset"`). Provides `WebViewId`, `HttpRequest`, and expects `HttpResponse`.
- **`with_asynchronous_custom_protocol`** — Async variant; the handler also receives a `RequestAsyncResponder`. The docs note: "the protocol name doesn’t explicitly need to be a `String`" but must implement `ToString`.
- **`with_navigation_handler`** — "Set a custom navigation handler for non-dioxus URLs. Return true to allow navigation inside the webview, false to block."

## Visual & Rendering

- **`with_background_color`** — "Sets the background color of the WebView. This will be set before the HTML is rendered and can be used to prevent flashing." Accepts RGBA tuple `(u8, u8, u8, u8)`.
- **`with_disable_dma_buf_on_wayland`** — Controls DMA-BUF usage on Wayland. "Defaults to true to avoid issues on some systems."
- **`with_disable_context_menu`** — Whether to disable the right-click context menu.
- **`with_disable_drag_drop_handler`** — "On Windows the drop handler must be disabled for HTML drag and drop APIs to work."

## Platform-Specific WebView

- **`with_windows_browser_args`** — "Add additional windows only launch arguments for webview2."
- **`with_data_directory`** — Sets the directory for WebView2 user data (cookies, cache, IndexedDB). On Windows, it defaults to `%LOCALAPPDATA%/<exe_name>`; on macOS/Linux it's managed by WebKit automatically.

## **Not Present:** `with_file_handler`

There is **no `with_file_handler` method** listed anywhere in this Config documentation. If you need file serving, `with_custom_protocol` or `with_asynchronous_custom_protocol` would be the closest alternatives.

## JavaScript Settings

No dedicated "enable/disable JavaScript" method appears in this API surface. The `wry` WebView that backs Dioxus Desktop controls JS internally, but Dioxus does not expose a toggle through this Config struct.
